name: OP249
tagline: PMI/ADI's fast (22 V/µs) precision JFET dual, 'highly recommended' in the 1993 rec.audio FAQ.

lineage.note: Macromodel credits 'JCB / PMI'; A/E/F/G grades follow PMI's scheme. Introduction date unconfirmed.
Model carries 'Copyright 1990 by Analog Devices'. Rev. I datasheet live; ADWIL fab transfer (PCN 10_0062). No second source.

part_numbers.note: Base part; standard 8-pin dual pinout. ADI product page and Rev. I datasheet live.
G grade, PDIP-8, −40 to +85 °C. GPZ broker-listed 'Active'; GP probably superseded.
G grade, SOIC-8, −40 to +85 °C. GSZ 'Active' at a broker; GS probably superseded.
A grade, −55 to +125 °C; probably ceramic DIP (unconfirmed).
F grade, CERDIP-8, −40 to +85 °C; RS lists it. F columns dropped (Table 3).
PMI grades with typical and worst-case macromodels. E grade probably discontinued; no orderable seen.

key_specs.condition: OP249G, no load; per amp unconfirmed

key_specs.value: 200 µV EOS; Ios 3 pA typ, 12.5 pA A-grade (model)

key_specs.source: ADI product page; PMI SPICE model

reputation.summary: Thin, mostly historical. Bob Neidorff's 1993 rec.audio Audio FAQ lists OP249 among 'highly recommended' audio duals with OPA2604, AD797, LT1115 and HA5112, noting FET parts suit line-level, high-impedance signals. Fosi Audio lists it as a DIP-8 rolling option for the ZA3. A SOWA synth mixer chose it for 'low offset and good dynamic parameters'. No measured reviews.
typical_uses: DIP-8 op-amp rolling (e.g. Fosi Audio ZA3)
DC-coupled CV/audio mixers in synth DIY (SOWA)
caveats: A faster op-amp swapped into existing gear may oscillate (general FAQ warning).
17 nV/√Hz is noisier than bipolar audio duals; output drive unconfirmed for headphone duty.
Reputation rests on a 1990s FAQ and vendor lists; no modern measurements.
Parts from before and after the c. 2010 fab transfer and mask change may differ in offset.

counterfeit_notes: No specific fake reports (not searched in depth). Leaded GP/GS and old ceramic parts are mostly broker stock. Check logo, marking, date code; measure supply current (~5.6 mA), offset, slew (22 V/µs). Genuine parts differ around 2010 (PCN 10_0062).

silicon_changes.summary: PCN 10_0062 says OP249 moved to ADI's ADWIL (Wilmington) wafer fab and then showed more Vos variation. That led to the mask and passivation fixes in the die-redesign entry. Transfer date not known.
silicon_changes.identification: Not documented; only lot or date code could separate pre- and post-transfer wafers.

spec_deltas.before: earlier fab (not named in the sources seen)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Probably negligible: the effect is on DC offset variation; no AC change reported.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same design and pinout; wider offset spread on post-transfer lots before the fix.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN background confirmed: 'The transfer of the OP249 to the ADWIL wafer fab identified … more Vos variation'.

silicon_changes.summary: PCN 10_0062 'OP249 Data sheet and Die Changes': minor mask change for diode performance and stability, and lower-stress passivation on ceramic DIP to improve Vos. Both pre-qualified on the military version. Includes Group C data and old-versus-new spec comparison.
silicon_changes.identification: No marking change documented; use date code versus PCN effective date. Passivation change applies to CERDIP (OP249FZ, probably OP249AZ).

spec_deltas.after: minor mask change to improve diode performance and stability

spec_deltas.parameter: Offset voltage and Vos temperature coefficient limits (data sheet Table 4)
spec_deltas.after: changed (the Rev. I history lists 'Changes to Offset Voltage Parameter and Offset Voltage Temperature Coefficient Parameter, Table 4'); linking this to the PCN is an inference
deleted (per the revision history; timing relative to the PCN not verified)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Probably negligible: targets offset stability; slew, GBW and noise not reported changed.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same pinout; only Vos/TCVos specs revised, relevant to DC-precision circuits.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN title and content confirmed, plus Group C attachment; effective date not captured.
